name: Ferrogate Freight Elevator Platform
description: Massive open-air elevator platforms built into the sides of mega-structures and industrial towers, capable of lifting entire vehicles and cargo containers between street level and upper commercial floors. They're slow, loud, and essential — without the Freight Elevators, the upper floors of Meridian 88's tower blocks would be unreachable by anything heavier than a person. The platforms have no walls, just safety rails and a prayer. Riding one up forty stories on an open slab of metal with a loaded cargo trike is an experience that never gets comfortable.
cost: Φ5-20 per use depending on weight
common_usage: Moving cargo and vehicles to upper floors, construction material delivery, vertical logistics.
story_hooks: A Freight Elevator descends past the basement level and keeps going — someone has extended the shaft into the Underworld
The elevator operator has been running a clandestine passenger service to floors that don't appear on the building directory
